what: The special attack of a Genesis is the signature of its Eyes: five shapes, each firing and dealing its own damage in online matches.
build_status_detail: WebGL build finished. Genesis roster: 1969 heroes, 3 of 3 roles with a character, 5 of 5 shapes with a signature, ruleset genesis-0.3.0, asset [065760736FC09D1D].
method: Two online matches in headless Chrome (one idle human, five bots), 75 s and 90 s. With ?perf=1 the game logs one CHOG_COMBAT line per skill use and per damage event; the lines were counted from the browser console.

authored_numbers.beam: 1400 damage, radius 0.35, speed 24 for 0.45 s, stops at walls
authored_numbers.wave: 1100 damage, radius 1.5, speed 9 for 0.75 s, passes over walls
authored_numbers.flash: 1600 damage, radius 1.7, standing 2 units in front for 0.35 s
authored_numbers.nova: 1300 damage, radius 3 around the caster for 0.4 s
authored_numbers.puddle: 600 damage per second for 3 s, radius 3, lobbed up to 8 units

observed: All five signature skills fired at least once across the two runs, and each of the five authored damage values appeared at least once.
No class special of the sample (Knight, Archer or Spellcaster special) fired: every special used was a Genesis signature.
No error and no missing-asset warning in the browser console.
tests: python3 tools/quantum/headless.py test: 30 catalog checks and 19 Quantum tests pass, including 'a Genesis fires the signature of its Eyes, whatever class its Body gives'.
limits: Fired by bots; no human fired a signature in these runs, and the aim preview of the special was not seen.
Counts come from one client's console; a damage value proves a hit of that attack, not that its area or timing feel right.
Visuals are borrowed from the sample's attack prefabs and do not match the size of each area.
The numbers are placeholders: no kit budget, no balance pass.
Effect (Aura) and delivery (Base and Tier) change nothing yet: every signature is raw and direct.
Software rendering, no phone, no second device.
